00087:     entry.promise = produce(program, ranges, controller.signal)
00088:       .then((value) => { entry.result = value; return value; })

00094: 
00095: export function globalReferenceStats(program, regions, { signal } = {}) {
00096:   if (!program) return Promise.resolve({ counts:new Map(), scannedRefs:0, complete:false, reason:'program-index-unavailable' });
00097:   const ranges = dataRanges(regions);
00098:   const entry = entryFor(program, ranges);
00099:   if (entry.result) return Promise.resolve(entry.result);
00100:   entry.waiters++;
00101: 
00102:   return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
00103:     let settled = false;
00104:     const finish = (fn, value) => {
00105:       if (settled) return;
00106:       settled = true;
00107:       signal?.removeEventListener?.('abort', onAbort);
00108:       entry.waiters = Math.max(0, entry.waiters - 1);
00109:       fn(value);
00110:     };

00196: function functionsFromSymbols(symbols,limit=MAX_DIFF_FUNCTIONS){

00201:   }

00204:   return out;

00704:   async ensureBinaryId(options = {}) {
00705:     if (this.binaryId) return this.binaryId;
00706:     if (!this.file) throw new Error('binary-id-file-unavailable');
00707:     const file = this.file;
00708:     if (!this._binaryIdPromise) {
00709:       this._binaryIdPromise = sha256BlobHex(file, {
00710:         chunkBytes:options.chunkBytes,
00711:         signal:options.signal ?? null,
00712:         onProgress:options.onProgress,
00713:       }).then((result) => {
00714:         if (this.file !== file) throw new StaleRequestError();
00715:         const binaryId = createBinaryIdFromDigest(result.hex);
00716:         this.binaryId = binaryId;
00717:         return binaryId;
00718:       }).catch((error) => {
00719:         this._binaryIdPromise = null;
00720:         throw error;
00721:       });
00722:     }
00723:     return this._binaryIdPromise;
00724:   }

00115: export async function sha256BlobHex(blob, options = {}) {
00116:   if (!blob || !Number.isSafeInteger(blob.size) || blob.size < 0 || typeof blob.slice !== 'function') throw new TypeError('sha256 source must be a Blob/File-like object with a safe integer size');
00117:   const chunkBytes = options.chunkBytes ?? 1024 * 1024;
00118:   if (!Number.isSafeInteger(chunkBytes) || chunkBytes <= 0) throw new TypeError('chunkBytes must be a positive safe integer');
00119:   const signal = options.signal ?? null;
00120:   const hash = new IncrementalSha256();
00121:   let reads = 0, bytesRead = 0, largestRead = 0;
00122:   for (let offset = 0; offset < blob.size; offset += chunkBytes) {
00123:     throwIfAborted(signal);
00124:     const end = Math.min(blob.size, offset + chunkBytes);
00125:     const part = blob.slice(offset, end);
00126:     if (!part || typeof part.arrayBuffer !== 'function') throw new TypeError('sha256 source slices must provide arrayBuffer()');
00127:     const bytes = new Uint8Array(await part.arrayBuffer());
00128:     throwIfAborted(signal);
00129:     if (bytes.byteLength !== end - offset) throw new Error(`sha256 truncated read: expected ${end - offset}, received ${bytes.byteLength}`);
00130:     hash.update(bytes);

00152: function beats(next, current) {
00153:   if (!next?.top) return false;
00154:   if (!current?.top) return true;
00155:   const rank = verdictRank(next.verdict) - verdictRank(current.verdict);
00156:   if (rank !== 0) return rank > 0;
00157:   return Number(next.top?.fusion?.probability || 0) > Number(current.top?.fusion?.probability || 0);
00158: }

00175:         .catch((error) => { this.shared.delete(key); throw error; });
